1.x: **Dyarchy (diarchy):** "double rule" (Greek *di-arche*) – the **subjects delegated to the provinces** were divided into two categories, **reserved** and **transferred**.

**Introduced by:** the **Government of India Act, 1919** = **Montagu-Chelmsford (Mont-Ford) Reforms** – in the **provinces**; it gave provincial governments more powers. The earlier Acts of **1861, 1892** and **1909** (Morley-Minto) had no dyarchy.
**Aim:** partial **responsible government** in the provinces – the transferred half was run by ministers answerable to the legislature; dyarchy divided the administration into two sections.
